task: Deepen flagship 10 (open-tennis-robots): deck-side cable run and stepper driver mount (allocate.py row 8, BUILDABLE HERE)

errors.what: First cable solids were a boolean fuse of cylinders and balls; OCC silently dropped the deck stretch, so a full build reported no collisions for a cable it never saw.
errors.fixed: Swept circle along lines and true arcs; volume equals pi r^2 x routed length; a test shifts the run into the battery and requires a clash.

errors.what: First stepper-driver carrier placement put its M3 holes off the deck's grid (grid x is -645 + 10k).
errors.fixed: Moved to (-605, 155); a test checks every carrier and saddle hole lands on a deck hole.

doc_friction.issue: The lift/agitator GPIO 16/17 clash with UART2 sat in CAD notes, firmware and BOM for a day; the controller tests never touch main.py's hardware layer, so nothing could catch it. tests/test_pins.py now does.

goal: Land the flagship's buildable CAD item: route the fixed cables from the deck to the axis clamp with the stepper's and lift's leads, a driver mount, and checks the build enforces.
notes: Landed: deck-side cable run (main, stepper, lift) as swept solids in all_parts, 5 saddles, 3 hangers, StepStick carrier, 6 new deck holes; Feeder.deck_cable_paths/route/ties/electrics/check_deck_cables wired into check() and the manifest; servo_supply uses the routed length (1.79 m, was 1.71). Firmware: lift/agitator moved from GPIO 16/17 (UART2 to the Pi, which run() opens last) to GPIO 12/2; tests/test_pins.py loads main.py against a fake machine module and checks the pin map for both roles (fails on the old code at exactly 16 and 17). Verification: full feeder build (all sweeps) design_rules [] collisions []; committed package regenerated in place; run_venture_tests open-tennis-robots passes; DeckCable* tests 7/7 under build123d 0.13.0; full cad suite and venture-preflight run locally (results appended below).
